thread_pair_example: compute_delta_page_string_sizes_kernel, block 0: warp 0 lane 5 reads prefixes.current_value_idx at page_string_decode.cu L455 in the last pass of a mini-block (calc_mini_block_pass ends with warp.sync() at delta_binary.cuh L320, which orders earlier passes, but there is no sync after the read), while warp 0 lane 0 leaves the pass loop and executes setup_next_mini_block at L465, which writes current_value_idx at delta_binary.cuh L208. Under independent thread scheduling lane 0 may advance before lane 5 has read. Identical pair in warp 1 for the suffix decoder. Second instance: compute_delta_length_page_string_sizes_kernel, thread 5 reads string_lengths.current_value_idx at L779 vs thread 0 writes at delta_binary.cuh L208 via L785.
class_reason: Both accesses are ordinary (non-volatile, non-atomic) accesses to a member of a __shared__ struct (verify.strong_accesses: none) by different lanes of one warp with no warp barrier between them (the only warp.sync() in the loop body is at L466, after the write; the sync inside calc_mini_block_pass at delta_binary.cuh L320 precedes the read). Plain vs plain unordered conflicting pair = DR under D20; it is an ITS-style intra-warp race: lanes are likely converged on current hardware (no wrong output in practice), racecheck labels it a Warning.
buggy_expected: the pair (page_string_decode.cu L455 read by lanes != 0) x (delta_binary.cuh L208 write by lane 0) on current_value_idx is reported as DR (intra-warp shared WAR); the fix commit's racecheck lists [1250960 hazards] for ParquetStringsTest.ReadLargeStrings (read L455 vs write delta_binary.cuh:208)

fixed.reason: The fix inserts `warp.sync();` immediately before the lane-0-only setup_next_mini_block(true) at fixed page_string_decode.cu L465 (call now at L466, trailing warp.sync() at L467) and the same in compute_delta_length_page_string_sizes_kernel (fixed L786 sync, L787 call, L788 sync). Fixed read L455 and delta_binary.cuh L208 are unchanged. All lanes' reads of the last pass therefore happen before lane 0's write. verify.expected_report_fixed: nothing for that pair. Earlier passes are already ordered by the warp.sync() at the end of calc_mini_block_pass (delta_binary.cuh L320).
